title: Blender 5.2 static owner-erosion radius-2 versus radius-3 fresh intervention holdout
question: On fresh opaque static multi-owner geometry, does increasing the current-owner erosion radius from 2 to 3 remove the D12.4 first-eligible-ring tail while retaining useful coverage and at least twofold RGB-maximum headroom under the unchanged D12.2 production tolerance?
decisionRole: fresh confirmatory intervention holdout derived from D12.4; D12.3 remains unchanged

derivation.observedOnly: On reused D12.3 arrays, all fixture maxima occurred at silhouette distance 3; filtering to distance >=4 reduced the cross-fixture RGB maximum to 4.76837158203125e-7, exactly 25% of the frozen gate.
derivation.confirmatoryBoundary: No D12.3 source, array or output may be a D12.5 measurement input. Radius 3 is unsupported until this holdout completes.

requirements: Every fixture identifier, raster, lens, sensor width, camera transform, owner identifier, pass index, geometry parameter, material parameter and output path is fresh relative to D12.2 and D12.3.
All seven formal tool paths, the preflight root and the formal root are absent at preregistration.
No D12.2 or D12.3 EXR, array, mask, report or metric may be a D12.5 measurement input.
No formal D12.5 render, adapter, consumer or analyzer output may be inspected before tool freeze and accepted preflight.

sceneContract.staticRule: Every object and camera transform is identical at all three LINEAR keys; topology, modifier state and procedural material parameters are constant.

materialContract.surface: object-local procedural emission, alpha 1.0; world emission zero

consumerContract.common: Both radii consume the same adapted scene-linear float32 Combined, Vector and Object Index arrays. Reconstruction arithmetic and previous-tap owner/alpha checks are identical to D12.3.
consumerContract.radius2Control: Current pixel and every current neighbor within Chebyshev radius 2 must share the same registered owner and alpha >0.999; all four previous bilinear taps must share that owner and alpha.
consumerContract.radius3Intervention: Identical rule with current-neighborhood Chebyshev radius 3; previous bilinear-tap rule is unchanged.
consumerContract.subsetInvariant: Every radius-3 interior pixel must also be radius-2 interior. Radius-2-only pixels must have current-owner silhouette distance exactly 3.
consumerContract.boundaryRule: Every registered owner pixel excluded from a radius interior forms that radius's boundary diagnostic domain and preserves current-frame RGB; cross-owner and out-of-bounds taps fail closed.

radius3ConfirmatoryHeadroom.meaning: at least 2x headroom beneath the unchanged production RGB-maximum limit

identity: previous/current source RGBA bytes exact within each repeat
repeat 1/repeat 2 source and consumer payload bytes exact
Python/Node reconstructed RGBA and both radius masks byte-identical
each producer document has identical Python/Node typed-envelope bytes
independent analyzer recomputes all decisions from payload arrays and ignores producer metrics
all 55 child process IDs are unique and all exit zero

decision.supportedWhen: All identity, subset, ownership, source-static, production-tolerance, radius-3 headroom and coverage gates pass in every fresh cell, and all registered attacks pass.
decision.boundedWhen: Radius 3 stays within the unchanged production tolerance but any confirmatory headroom or coverage gate fails.
decision.rejectedWhen: Any radius-3 production tolerance, identity, ownership, subset, static-source, execution or audit-totality gate fails.
decision.radius2Role: negative control and paired effect estimate; radius 2 is reported under the same metrics but is not required to fail
effectReport: per-cell radius-2 and radius-3 maximum, RMSE, interior and boundary counts
absolute and ratio change in maximum and RMSE
maximum by silhouette-distance ring and owner
whether either radius exactly reaches the production threshold

classes: radius label swap and mask substitution
coverage count, owner roster and retention-ratio fraud
producer metric injection or analyzer dependence
runtime, process-count, duplicate-PID, exit-code, model/network-count and disk-admission mutation

invalidRunPolicy: Any infrastructure failure, missing formal cell, preflight mismatch, root reuse, threshold change, unregistered correction, analyzer crash or incomplete attack totality invalidates the run. Retain the failed root; corrections require a new preregistration and fresh root.
nonClaims: D12.5 does not revise D12.3 or prove a Blender internal cause for the static Vector residue.
A supported radius 3 would apply only to the registered opaque static owner-interior domain, not motion, deformation, transparency, hair, particles, volumes, motion blur or disocclusion.
Boundary history reuse remains rejected for both radii.
No perceptual, cinematic-quality, temporal-stability or production-throughput claim is tested.
The registered fixtures cannot establish universality over arbitrary geometry or resolutions.
